claims.claim: 文本模型总参数 1.73B（dense，无激活/总参数区分）
claims.evidence_verbatim: | Parameters | 1.73B |
claims.crosscheck: docs.liquid.ai/lfm/models/lfm3-1.7b 同为 1.73B；config.json architectures=[Lfm3ForCausalLM] 为 dense

claims.claim: LFM3-Omni-2B 为 2.2B 参数；LFM3-VL-2B 博客表标注 1.9B
claims.evidence_verbatim: At 2.2B parameters, it brings this kind of multimodal assistant on-device.

claims.claim: tri-hybrid 层混合：24 层 = 13 门控短卷积 + 5 滑窗注意力(窗口256) + 6 全局注意力
claims.evidence_verbatim: Of its 24 layers, 13 are convolutions, 5 are SWA with a 256-token window, and 6 are global attention.
claims.crosscheck: config.json layer_types 精确序列逐层计数 conv=13/sliding=5/full=6，sliding_window=256, num_hidden_layers=24；HF 卡与 docs 同数

claims.claim: 卷积核大小 7（LFM2 为 3）
claims.evidence_verbatim: The convolutions also use a kernel size of 7, up from 3 in LFM2.

claims.claim: Head-wise gated attention：sigmoid 门逐头缩放输出
claims.evidence_verbatim: A sigmoid gate scales each head's output, so a head can switch off when it has nothing to add.

claims.claim: Partial RoPE：全局注意力仅旋转最高频一半；SWA 保持全 RoPE
claims.evidence_verbatim: Global attention layers rotate only the highest-frequency half of each head and leave the low-frequency half unrotated ... SWA layers keep full RoPE.

claims.claim: Sandwich norm：每块对输入与输出都归一化
claims.evidence_verbatim: Each block normalizes both its input and its output, which helps keep activations well-scaled.
claims.crosscheck: config.json use_sandwich_norm=true；modeling_lfm3.py 三处 use_sandwich_norm 分支

claims.claim: 注意力为 GQA：16 查询头 / 4 KV 头，head_dim=128，hidden=2048
claims.evidence_verbatim: "num_attention_heads": 16, "num_key_value_heads": 4, "head_dim": 128, "hidden_size": 2048

claims.claim: 理论状态缩放：若运行时裁剪滑窗缓存，仅 6 个全局注意力层 KV 随上下文线性增长；5 个 SWA 层仅保留 256-token 窗口；卷积层保留固定核窗口状态。未实测运行时内存。
claims.evidence_verbatim: layer_types: [conv ... sliding_attention ... full_attention] + "sliding_window": 256 + "conv_L_cache": 7
claims.note: BF16 原始张量推导：6×2×4×128×2B = 12,288 B/token = 12 KiB/token。131,072 tokens 的全局 KV 为 1,610,612,736 B，262,144 tokens 为 3,221,225,472 B。5 个滑窗层理论保留窗口共 2,621,440 B = 2.5 MiB（每层 524,288 B），以运行时裁剪为条件。权重、卷积状态、分配器与工作区另计；不能推出 1 GB 设备可容纳 256K 上下文。非本地测量。

claims.claim: 厂商 KV 声称：128K 上下文 KV 缓存 1.6GB（对比 Qwen3.5-4B 4.3GB、MiniCPM5-2B 5.6GB）
claims.evidence_verbatim: a full 128K-token context needs 1.6 GB of KV cache, against 4.3 GB for Qwen3.5-4B and 5.6 GB for MiniCPM5-2B.
claims.note: 厂商报告值；未确认测量方法。C13 在 BF16、131072 tokens、裁剪滑窗缓存的假设下得到全局 KV 1.610612736 GB；不能据此推断总设备内存或宣称独立实测。

claims.claim: 预训练 22T tokens，最后 3.5T 为中期训练并扩展上下文至 256K
claims.evidence_verbatim: LFM3-1.7B-Base was pre-trained on 22T tokens. ... The final 3.5T tokens are a mid-training stage ... This stage also extends the context window to 256K tokens.
claims.crosscheck: Base 模型卡 Training 节同述；HF 卡图 alt 文本给出细分：~15T web/synthetic + 3T code/math/science(4K) + 3T curated agentic(32K) + 500B(128K) + 50B(256K)

claims.claim: 后训练四阶段：SFT(1.75T tokens) → 混合 RL → MOPD(6 个专家 RL 教师) → Agentic RL
claims.evidence_verbatim: Multi-domain on-policy distillation (MOPD): six specialist RL teachers (code, math, tool use, long context, agentic work, and enterprise workflows) are distilled back into a single model.
claims.crosscheck: HF 模型卡 Training 节四阶段同述
